written_results: For x>=1, with V zero below one and alpha=2^(-1/2), L(x)=V(x)-(1+alpha)V(x/2)+alpha*V(x/4) equals the exact signed sum over x/4<n<=x of compact atoms supported on [n,4n].
V(x)=sum_(k=0..floor(log_2(x))) c_k L(x/2^k), c_k=sum_(j=0..k)alpha^j. Finite causal reconstruction retains all startup and historical source.

For every sigma>0,T>=0: H_sigma(T)<=R_sigma Gamma_sigma(T), Gamma_sigma(T)<=U_sigma H_sigma(T), R=[(1-2^-sigma)(1-2^(-sigma-1/2))]^-2, U=[(1+2^-sigma)(1+2^(-sigma-1/2))]^2. No half-line integrability premise.
At sigma=1/3: R<123 and U<8 by explicit rational power inequalities. These bound the change of representation, not the actual uniform energy.
The finite localized Gram vanishes when max(m,n)>=4min(m,n), while every finite time truncation and ordered pair is retained.
Its nonnegative diagonal is <=(5/2)c<9/10, with c the explicitly evaluated full localized single-atom mass.
Uniform localized cross-energy upper bounds on J*log(2) are equivalent to uniform one-third energy; a witness C returns H<=123(C+9/10). No witness is supplied.
Local arithmetic formulation: S(x)=sum_(x/4<n<=x)mu(n)psi(n/x), Gamma_(1/3)(log R)=int_1^R x^(-8/3)|S(x)|^2 dx, with the complete piecewise weight psi written explicitly.
A dyadic bound int_(2^j)^(2^(j+1))|S(x)|^2 dx<=C*2^(8j/3)/(j+1)^(1+epsilon) would give H<=123*C*(1+1/epsilon). This supplier remains unpaid.
Constant-one coefficients give Gamma(log R)>=3*(R^(1/3)-2)/1024 for R>=8. A source-independent uniform estimate is false.
At zero damping the single-atom source has infinite original energy and compactly supported localized reading; the positive-damping condition cannot be dropped.
The initial-domain Laplace multiplier (1-2^-z)(1-2^(-z-1/2)) has no zeros for Re(z)>0 and cannot cancel a hypothetical off-critical zeta pole of the reciprocal.
